Compute event-locked multivariate PCA compression scores across spatial units

Source: R/event_lock_timeseries.R
get_medusa_compression_score.Rd

Compute event-locked multivariate PCA compression scores across spatial units

Usage

get_medusa_compression_score(
  fmri_obj,
  event = NULL,
  time_before = -3,
  time_after = 3,
  collide_before = NULL,
  collide_after = NULL,
  group_by = NULL,
  events = NULL,
  tr = NULL,
  time = NULL,
  time_offset = NULL,
  parcel_ids = NULL,
  unit_data = NULL,
  value_name = "value",
  trial_col = "trial",
  pexp_target = 0.9,
  scale_columns = TRUE,
  use_legacy = FALSE
)

Arguments

fmri_obj

an fmri_ts object, numeric T x V matrix, or single-run "medusa_nifti_ts" object

event

the event to which the fmri time series should be aligned (column in fmri_obj$event_data or events)

time_before

How many seconds before the event do we want data. Default: -3

time_after

How many seconds after the event do we want data. Default: 3

collide_before

An optional vector of column names in trial_df that set a boundary on the earliest time point used in interpolation. This effectively truncates the time series for interpolation to a smaller window than specified by time_before.

collide_after

An optional vector of column names in trial_df that set a boundary on the latest time point used in interpolation. This effectively truncates the time series for interpolation to a smaller window than specified by time_after.

group_by

return compression scores for each combination of group_by variables.

events

Optional trial-level data.frame for matrix inputs.

tr

Optional repetition time in seconds for matrix inputs.

time

Optional numeric vector of acquisition timestamps for matrix inputs.

time_offset

Optional scalar start-time offset in seconds for matrix inputs.

parcel_ids

Optional vector assigning matrix columns to parcels/ROIs.

unit_data

Optional data.frame of unit metadata for matrix inputs.

value_name

Signal name prefix for single-signal matrix inputs. Default "value".

trial_col

Trial identifier column name for matrix inputs. Default "trial".

pexp_target

Target cumulative variance proportion(s) passed to compress_mts_pca(). Default 0.9.

scale_columns

Logical; standardize columns prior to SVD. Default TRUE.

use_legacy

Logical; force legacy fmri_ts path when TRUE.
